text:
Alex: Quick sync — long-term platform roadmap: routing policies, multi-region, multi-tenant isolation. We need a prioritized initiative list, launch criteria, and clear owner per initiative. Can we surface customer asks that push timelines?
Diego: +1. I'm thinking three horizon buckets: 0-6m (policy DSL + canary guardrails), 6-12m (regional failover + tenant affinity), 12-24m (full isolation lanes + on-prem orchestration).
Priya: For 0-6m we can do Policy DSL proto + rollout hooks. Need eng ETA: ~8w if we drop other sprints.
Lina: SRE concerns: SLOs and eviction playbook missing. Need acceptance criteria: recovery <5m for regional failover, token-level observability for canaries.
Tom: Sales: a large customer is asking for geo-residency and private VPC within 9 months. That pushes 6-12m items earlier.
Jin: ML: model-aware routing (fall back to quantized variants) will impact runtime; need interface contract with serving runtime.
Diego: Action item: draft decision matrix linking customer ask -> minimum viable deliverable -> gating criteria. I'll start.
Alex: Launch criteria proposal: (1) Canary pass on 10 customers for 2 weeks, (2) documented rollback plan + automated fallback, (3) SLOs met for p95 latency + no data egress.
Priya: Tech checklist snippet:
```
- policy-dsl v0.1
- canary routing hooks
- metrics: per-tenant latency/cost
- fallback: model-variant mapping
```
Lina: Add: chaos test for cross-region partitioning + DR runbook.
Tom: Customer ask: "data must stay in EU region and failover only to EU-B" — we need gating for jurisdictional routing.
Diego: Tradeoffs: stronger isolation increases capacity overhead (est. +20%) and complexity of routing templates. Need product decision on economics vs compliance.
Alex: Proposed prioritization: 1) jurisdictional routing (customer blocker), 2) policy DSL + canary hooks, 3) regional failover automation, 4) isolation lanes. Thoughts?
Priya: Agree with prioritization. Need resource ask to leadership for extra 2 engineers for 3 months to hit 9-month target.
Jin: Note: model caching + KV eviction interacts with isolation lanes — let's lock on KV cache semantics early.
Diego: I'll prepare a short spec for the policy DSL and the decision matrix by EOD Friday.
Alex: Thanks — can everyone reply with explicit thumbs-up/thumbs-down on the prioritization by tomorrow noon? :thumbsup: :thumbsdown:
deployer-bot: deployment queued: infra/prod-policy-dsl (sha: abcd1234) — will run canaries.
Priya: 👍 on prioritization.
Lina: 👍 but we need SRE time budgeted.
Tom: 👍 from sales; will update customer with proposed timeline.
Jin: 👍 will sync model-runtime contract.
Diego: 👍 working on spec.
Alex: Closing — owners: Diego (policy DSL), Priya (canary rollout), Lina (SRE acceptance), Tom (customer comms). Will convert into tickets.
